reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but the range handler independently implements the daily skipping policy introduced in getNextDate.

duplication.why: The range handler repeats recurrence enumeration and adjustment orchestration from getUpcomingDates and duplicates daily exclusion decisions from getNextDate.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared schedules, but the server range handler also owns scheduling policy that should be shared with other occurrence consumers.

scope.why: All edits address the requested scheduling rules, range endpoint, configuration plumbing, or associated tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several occurrence-processing paths because daily skipping and holiday adjustment are not expressed through one shared policy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts:getDatesInRange independently decides daily exclusions instead of sharing the occurrence policy implemented in shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange expresses daily weekend and holiday exclusion as map/filter processing, while getNextDate expresses the same decision through a local predicate and find.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; getNextDate adds daily-specific candidate selection and adjustment exclusion; the added getDatesInRange and modified getUpcomingDates retain separate occurrence-policy paths.
